task: Isolate generic critical MUST_CREATE regression fixture from inherited parent closure authority so generic remains BLOCK and only explicit canonical parent closure remains eligible.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: CI #9228, #9230 and #9231 failed a single Control Plane Operational Intelligence regression test on closure PR #1138. Test copies canonical quality/development/active-plan.json, which on the CLOSED metadata closure branch inherits parentClosureContext, then falsely treats a mustCreate-only plan as generic. Production validator correctly regards it as governed parent closure. Isolate fixture context in test, without relaxing any production gate, source, proof or receipt.
observableOutcomes: The generic critical MUST_CREATE-only test removes inherited parent and child closure contexts and must report DEV_PLAN_SEMANTIC_EXECUTION_ROUTE_REQUIRED.
The explicitly added canonical parentClosureContext allows MUST_CREATE-only targeting while preserving all other authority, proof and unknown route requirements.
The separate canonical child release context also allows governed MUST_CREATE-only targeting, and a noncanonical contract cannot grant exemption.
The same regression test passes on an ordinary main plan and an actual persisted CLOSED parent closure plan.
The untouched source and receipt-bound closure artifact retain their exact identities; no gates are weakened.
unresolvedRisks: Persistent active-plan.json is environment-dependent and may contain multiple governed transaction contexts; tests must clear both explicitly.
Generic unit fixture might accidentally inherit route or authority of an unrelated plan and need fixed required fields.
Other tests depending on active-plan.json may have the same anti-pattern, but scope remains this reproduced failure unless other blockers arise.

out: No code change to scripts/lib/shoperation-operational-intelligence.mjs or any production release, plan, edit-time, lifecycle or trust gate.
No change to source SHA, U01-U03, canonical release-state branch, PR #1138 closure proof or CI/workflows.
No relaxing MUST_CREATE/authority/proof requirements and no Builder/Template changes.
